fills.researcher_notes: Company-level Operator question, resolved once for the whole Transco brief and applied to every row of the system (P0271, P3296, P3669) per gotcha 4. Transco's own FY2023 Form 10-K (registrant 'Transcontinental Gas Pipe Line Company, LLC', CIK 0000099250) states it is a Delaware limited liability company operating the interstate pipeline system; sec.gov 403'd the default UA and the verifier retried with an identifying UA per SEC's fair-access policy. Independently, FERC's Nov 21, 2017 certificate order in Docket CP16-494 (Gulf Connector Expansion) opens by naming 'Transcontinental Gas Pipe Line Company, LLC (Transco)' as the NGA sec.7(c) applicant/certificate holder for this same pipeline system -- a federal agency's own identification of the operator, independent of Transco's/Williams' own filing. No merger churn applies here (unlike Enable/Magellan/MountainWest/EGTS) -- Transco has been operated under this exact legal name by Williams since well before this packet's scope; verified current as of the FY2023 10-K and the still-current williams.com/pipeline/transco/ page. Existing sheet spelling elsewhere in this tracker varies ('Transcontinental Gas Pipeline LLC' on P0156; 'Trancontinental Gas Pipe Line Co LLC', a typo, already staged pre-existing and unflagged on P7800/P7805, left untouched as out of scope for this flag) -- this fill uses the exact legal name as it appears on the SEC filing. Operator is written 'Transcontinental Gas Pipe Line Company, LLC' by the source; spelled the ownership team's way as 'Transcontinental Gas Pipe Line Company LLC'.
